statements.statement: The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The patient is being managed for newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation
A 30-day mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The study is ordered to evaluate the burden of arrhythmia and correlate it with recent neurological symptoms
The study is ordered to assess for paroxysmal episodes and guide anticoagulation therapy
The diagnoses addressed are Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.91
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on the absence of required precertification or authorization prior to service delivery
